attributes.Name: AssessmentIdentifier
attributes.Description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity. This may be the publisher identifier.

attributes.Name: AssessmentShortName
attributes.Description: An abbreviated title for an assessment.

attributes.Name: AssessmentTitle
attributes.Description: The title name or name of the assessment

attributes.Name: AssessmentProvider
attributes.Description: Identifies the provider or publisher of the assessment.

attributes.Name: AssessmentRevisionDate
attributes.Description: The month, day, and year that the conceptual design for the assessment was most recently revised substantially

attributes.Name: AssessmentType
attributes.Description: The category of an assessment based on format and content.

attributes.Name: AssessmentObjective
attributes.Description: This is the objective that the assessment is measuring

attributes.Name: GoalDescription
attributes.Description: A statement that describes the desired outcomes.

attributes.Name: GoalSuccessCriteria
attributes.Description: One or more statements that describes the criteria used by teachers and students to check for attainment of a goal.

attributes.Name: AssessmentAcademicSubject
attributes.Description: The description of the academic content or subject area (e.g., arts, mathematics, reading, or a foreign language) being evaluated.

attributes.Name: AssessmentPurpose
attributes.Description: The reason for which an assessment is designed or delivered

attributes.Name: AssessmentLevelForWhichDesigned
attributes.Description: The typical grade or combination of grade-levels, developmental leves, or age-levels for which an assessment is designed

attributes.Name: AssessmentTypeAdministered
attributes.Description: The type of assessment administered

attributes.Name: AssessmentScoreMetricType
attributes.Description: The specific method used to report the performance and achievement of the assessment. This is the metric that is being used to derive the scores.

attributes.Name: AssessmentLanguage
attributes.Description: The language in which the assessment form is designed to be delivered

attributes.Name: AssessmentPerformanceLevelIdentifier
attributes.Description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment performance level.

attributes.Name: AssessmentPerformanceLevelLabel
attributes.Description: A label representing the performance level appropriate for use on a report.

attributes.Name: AssessmentPerformanceLevelLowerCutScore
attributes.Description: Lowest possible score for the performance level.

attributes.Name: AssessmentPerformanceLevelUpperCutScore
attributes.Description: Highest possible score for the performance level.

attributes.Name: AssessmentPerformanceLevelDescriptiveFeedback
attributes.Description: A feedback message designed to be reported with the assessment performance level.

attributes.Name: DateIssued
attributes.Description: The date when the learning assessment was formally approved/issued.

attributes.Name: ContentStandard
attributes.Description: An indication as to whether an assessment conforms to a standard (e.g., local standard, statewide standard, regional standard, association standard).

attributes.Name: ActualStartDateTime
attributes.Description: Date and time the assessment actually began.

attributes.Name: ActualEndDateTime
attributes.Description: Date and time the assessment actually ended.

attributes.Name: awardedBy
attributes.Description: The awarding details of the learning assessment.

attributes.Name: ScoreValue
attributes.Description: A meaningful raw score, derived score, or statistical expression of the performance of a person on an assessment. The type of result is indicated by the Assessment Score Metric Type element. The results can be expressed as a number, percentile, range, level, etc. The score relates to all scored items or a sub test scoring one aspect of performance on the test. This value may or may not correspond to one or more Performance Levels.

attributes.Name: ScoreType
attributes.Description: Indicates the purpose for which this assessment score instance was recorded.

attributes.Name: ResultDataType
attributes.Description: The data type of the assessment result score value.

attributes.Name: CompletionStatus
attributes.Description: The completion and scoring status for an instance of a person taking an assessment.

attributes.Name: ReasonNotCompleting
attributes.Description: The primary reason a participant did not complete an assessment.

attributes.Name: TimeAssessed
attributes.Description: The overall time a learner actually spent during the assessment session.

attributes.Name: DeliveryDeviceDetails
attributes.Description: The details about the device or platform by with which the assessment was delivered to the learner.

attributes.Name: AssessmentSessionLocation
attributes.Description: The description of the place where an assessment is administered.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkIdentifierURI
attributes.Description: An unambiguous reference to the competency framework using a network-resolvable URI.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkTitle
attributes.Description: The name of the competency framework.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkDescription
attributes.Description: A textual description of the scope and contents of the competency framework.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkSubject
attributes.Description: The topic or academic subject of the competency framework.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkCreator
attributes.Description: The person or organization chiefly responsible for the intellectual content of the competency framework.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkPublisher
attributes.Description: The entity responsible for making the competency framework available.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkPublicationStatus
attributes.Description: The publication status of the competency framework is "Published".

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkPublicationDate
attributes.Description: The date on which this content was first published.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkJurisdiction
attributes.Description: A legal, quasi-legal, organizational or institutional domain of the entity mandating the use of the statement--e.g., California.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkValidStartDate
attributes.Description: The year, month and day the competency framework was adopted by the jurisdiction in which it was intended to apply.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkValidEndDate
attributes.Description: The year, month and day the competency framework was deprecated/replaced by the jurisdiction in which it was intended to apply.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkVersion
attributes.Description: Defines the revision of the competency framework as a version number or date.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkLanguage
attributes.Description: The default language of the text used for the content in the competency framework.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkLicense
attributes.Description: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the competency framework.

attributes.Name: CompetencyFrameworkRights
attributes.Description: The information about rights held in and over the resource.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionSequence
attributes.Description: A set of one or more alphanumeric characters and/or symbols denoting the positioning of the statement being described in a sequential listing of statements.

attributes.Name: lastChangeDateTime
attributes.Description: A system generated timestamp of the most recent change to this record. This conforms to ISO 8601 dateTime definition [ISO 8601].

attributes.Name: subjectURI
attributes.Description: A set of Link URIs denoting the set of subjects for the document as designated by the promulgating agency.

attributes.Name: officialSourceURL
attributes.Description: The URL link to the formal citation of the original achievement standards document created for humans.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionURI
attributes.Description: A network-resolvable Uniform Resource Locator (URL) pointing to the authoritative reference for the competency definition.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionCode
attributes.Description: A human-referenceable code designated by the publisher to identify the item in the hierarchy of competency definitions.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionStatement
attributes.Description: The text of the statement. The textual content that either describes a specific competency or describes a less granular group of competencies within the taxonomy of the competency framework.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionNodeName
attributes.Description: The name or label displayed on the node when this competency definition is used in learning.

attributes.Name: abbreviatedStatement
attributes.Description: An abbreviated version of the Full Statement.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionRightsHolder
attributes.Description: The person or organization owning or managing rights over the competency framework.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionTypeURL
attributes.Description: The class of statement in the structure of statements in the Competency Framework according to a controlled vocabulary, specified as a URI referencing a controlled vocabulary.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionEducationLevel
attributes.Description: The education level, grade level or primary instructional level at which a Competency Definition is intended.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionTypicalAgeRangeMinimum
attributes.Description: The typical minimum age at which a person learns the defined competency.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionTypicalAgRangeMaximum
attributes.Description: The typical maximum age at which a person learns the defined competency.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionLanguage
attributes.Description: The default language of the text used for the content in the competency definition statement.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionConceptKeyword
attributes.Description: The significant topicality of the competency definition using free-text keywords and phrases.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionVersion
attributes.Description: A label assigned by the publisher indicating the version of the competency framework statement.

attributes.Name: hasProgressionLevel
attributes.Description: Reference to a specific point in a progression model.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionCurrentVersionIndicator
attributes.Description: Indicates that this is the most current version of the Competency Definition.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionLicense
attributes.Description: The full text or URL reference to a legal document giving official permission to do something with the competency definition statement.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionNodeAccessibilityProfile
attributes.Description: When the Competency Definition is used as a node in a learning map, this element supports alternative pathways based on a learner's accessibility profile. The type selected indicates which accessibility profile the node is designed to address.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionTestabilityType
attributes.Description: Indicates if the competency described in the Competency Definition Statement can be tested using one or more assessment items.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMaximumValue
attributes.Description: The maximum value in the range of text complexity applicable to a language competency definition using the scaling system defined by Text Complexity System, e.g. Lexile(tm).

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMinimumValue
attributes.Description: The minimum value in the range of text complexity applicable to a language competency definition using the scaling system defined by Text Complexity System, e.g. Lexile(tm).

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexitySystem
attributes.Description: The scaling system used to specify the text complexity of a competency item.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionValidEndDate
attributes.Description: The year, month and day the competency definition was deprecated/replaced by the jurisdiction in which it was intended to apply.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionValidStartDate
attributes.Description: The year, month and day the competency definition was adopted by the jurisdiction in which it was intended to apply.

attributes.Name: altCodedNotation
attributes.Description: An alphanumeric notation or ID code identifying this competency in common use among end-users.

attributes.Name: ceterms-environmentalHazardType
attributes.Description: Type of condition in the physical work performance environment that entails risk exposures requiring mitigating processes; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

attributes.Name: requiredProficiencyLevel
attributes.Description: A minimum level of proficiency for a competency  associated with a position, role, course, or other item.

attributes.Name: desiredProficiencyLevel
attributes.Description: DefinitionText>An optimum or ideal level of proficiency for a competency with respect to an associated position, role, course, or other item. The proficiency level is expressed as a score, a point scale, or a mark among range of values.

attributes.Name: proficiencyAcquistionDifficulty
attributes.Description: A rating or score representing the difficulty of the particular competency to acquire.

attributes.Name: CompetencyAssociationIdentifierURI
attributes.Description: A URI that establishes uniqueness of an association between a competency definition and another competency item or other objects such as learning resources.

attributes.Name: CompetencyAssociationType
attributes.Description: Defines the nature of the association between a Competency Definition and an associated data object such as a Learning Resource, an Assessment Item, or even another Competency Definition.

attributes.Name: CompetencyAssociationConnectionCitation
attributes.Description: Any citation appropriate to evidence the connection between nodes.

attributes.Name: CompetencyAssociationDestinationNodeName
attributes.Description: Name of the destination node when the Competency Association is used as a connector in a learning map.

attributes.Name: CompetencyAssociationDestinationNodeURI
attributes.Description: URI of the destination node when the Competency Association is used as a connector in a learning map.

attributes.Name: CompetencyAssociationOriginNodeName
attributes.Description: Name of the origin node when the Competency Association is used as a connector in a learning map.

attributes.Name: CompetencyAssociationOriginNodeURI
attributes.Description: URI of the origin node when the Competency Association is used as a connector in a learning map.

attributes.Name: CompetencyAssociationWeight
attributes.Description: Indicates the relative significance this connection has for the destination node in a learning map.

attributes.Name: ceterms-physicalCapabilityType
attributes.Description: Type of physical activity required or expected in performance; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

attributes.Name: ceterms-sensoryCapabilityType
attributes.Description: Type of required or expected sensory capability; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

attributes.Name: CourseIdentifier
attributes.Description: The actual code that identifies the organization of subject matter and related learning experiences provided for the instruction of students.

attributes.Name: CourseTitle
attributes.Description: The descriptive name given to a course of study offered in a school or other institution or organization. In departmentalized classes at the elementary, secondary, and postsecondary levels (and for staff development activities), this refers to the name by which a course is identified (e.g., American History, English III). For elementary and other non-departmentalized classes, it refers to any portion of the instruction for which a grade or report is assigned (e.g., reading, composition, spelling, and language arts).

attributes.Name: CourseDescription
attributes.Description: A description of the course content and/or goals. Reference may be made to state or national content standards.

attributes.Name: CourseBeginDate
attributes.Description: The year, month and day an instance of a course officially began.

attributes.Name: CourseEndDate
attributes.Description: The year, month and day an instance of a course ends.

attributes.Name: CourseSectionTimeRequiredForCompletion
attributes.Description: The actual or estimated number of clock minutes required for course completion. This number is especially important for career and technical education course and may represent (in minutes) the clock hour requirement of the course, the number of minutes (or clock hours) of class time per week, times the number of equivalent weeks the class typically meets.

attributes.Name: CourseAcademicGradeScaleCode
attributes.Description: The grading scale used by an academic educational institution for an academic course.

attributes.Name: CourseAlignedWithStandards
attributes.Description: An indication whether a course is aligned with the established standards of a curriculum framework.

attributes.Name: CourseCodeSystem
attributes.Description: A system that is used to identify the organization of subject matter and related learning experiences provided for the instruction of students.

attributes.Name: CourseSubjectAbbreviation
attributes.Description: The alphabetic abbreviation of the academic department or discipline offering the course. It is one part of the total course identifier number.

attributes.Name: CreditValue
attributes.Description: The amount of credit available to the student who successfully meets the objectives of the course or learning opportunity based on the units defined by Credit Unit Type.

attributes.Name: RelatedCompetencyDefinitions
attributes.Description: An indication of the competency definition(s) addressed in the Course Section.

attributes.Name: StudentIdentifier
attributes.Description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a student by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.

attributes.Name: CourseAddDate
attributes.Description: The date an individual was added to an academic course at a school.

attributes.Name: CourseSectionEnrollmentStatusStartDate
attributes.Description: The date on which the enrollment status began related to a student enrolled in an instance of a course.

attributes.Name: CourseSectionEnrollmentStatusEndDate
attributes.Description: The date on which the enrollment status ended related to a student enrolled in an instance of a course.

attributes.Name: CourseDropDate
attributes.Description: The date on which the individual drops or withdraws from the course.

attributes.Name: CourseAcademicGrade
attributes.Description: The final grade awarded for participation in the course.

attributes.Name: CourseQualityPointsEarned
attributes.Description: The numerical value assigned to a letter grade to provide a basis of quantitative determination of an average.

attributes.Name: CourseOverrideSchool
attributes.Description: The school where the credit was earned if different from the institution reporting.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionIdentifierSystem
attributes.Description: A coding scheme that is used for identification and record-keeping purposes by a credentialing organization to refer to an achievement.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionIdentifier
attributes.Description: A globally unique identifier by which the creator/owner/provider of a credential recognizes the achievement in transactions with the external environment.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionAlternateName
attributes.Description: An alias for the credential, which may include acronyms, alphanumeric notations, and other forms of name abbreviations in common use such as PhD, MA, and BA.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionTitle
attributes.Description: The title assigned to the achievement.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionDescription
attributes.Description: A description of the achievement.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionStatusType
attributes.Description: The status of the credential offered by a credentialing organization.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionDateEffective
attributes.Description: Effective date of the content of a credential definition.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionCategoryType
attributes.Description: A category for defining a competency or qualification, achievement, personal or organizational quality, experience, attribute, or aspect of an identity typically used to indicate suitability.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionAssessmentMethodType
attributes.Description: The method used to conduct the assessment being referenced.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionCriteria
attributes.Description: The criteria for competency-based completion of the achievement/award.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionCriteriaURL
attributes.Description: The Uniform Resource Locator (URL) for the unique address of a web page describing the competency-based completion criteria for the achievement/award.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionEstimatedDuration
attributes.Description: The estimated amount of time in minutes it will take to earn the credential.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionMinimumDuration
attributes.Description: The minimum amount of time in minutes it will take to earn the described credential.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionMaximumDuration
attributes.Description: The maximum amount of time in minutes it will take to earn the described credential.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionMinimumAge
attributes.Description: The minimum allowed age in years at which a person is eligible for the credential.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionNAICSIndustryType
attributes.Description: The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) class identifier for an industry associated with the credential.

attributes.Name: CredentialImageURL
attributes.Description: The Uniform Resource Locator (URL) for the unique address of an image representing an award or badge associated with the achievement.

attributes.Name: CredentialDefinitionKeywords
attributes.Description: Keywords or key phrases describing aspects of a credential considered useful for its discovery.

attributes.Name: subject
attributes.Description: Words or brief phrases describing the topicality of the entity; select subject terms from an existing enumeration of such terms.

attributes.Name: CTDLAudienceLevelType
attributes.Description: Type of level indicating a point in a progression through an educational or training context, for which the credential is intended; select from an existing enumeration of such types.

attributes.Name: ClassificationOfInstructionalProgramCode
attributes.Description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.

attributes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionURL
attributes.Description: A network-resolvable Uniform Resource Locator (URL) pointing to the authoritative reference for the competency definition.

attributes.Name: O*NET-SOCOccupationType
attributes.Description: The O*NET-SOC taxonomy defines the set of occupations across the world of work based on the Standard Occupational Classification.

attributes.Name: expirationDate
attributes.Description: The date when the credential expires. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

attributes.Name: issuanceDate
attributes.Description: Defines the date and time, when the European Digital Credential becomes valid. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

attributes.Name: owner
attributes.Description: The person (subject) about which claims are made and who owns the credential. This property is inherited from Verifiable Credential.

attributes.Name: proof
attributes.Description: The proof of the european digital credential.

attributes.Name: termsOfUse
attributes.Description: The terms of use of european digital credential.

attributes.Name: evidenceAccreditation
attributes.Description: The accreditation of the evidence.

attributes.Name: evidenceStatement
attributes.Description: The statement of the evidence.

attributes.Name: evidenceTarget
attributes.Description: The target of the evidence.

attributes.Name: type
attributes.Description: The type of the evidence.

attributes.Name: CTID
attributes.Description: Globally unique Credential Transparency Identifier (CTID) by which the creator, owner or provider of a resource recognizes it in transactions with the external environment (e.g., in verifiable claims involving the resource).

attributes.Name: accreditedBy
attributes.Description: Quality assurance organization that provides official authorization to, or approval of, a credential, organization, assessment, or learning opportunity.

attributes.Name: accredits
attributes.Description: Credential, assessment, organization, or learning opportunity for which this organization provides official authorization or approval based on prescribed standards or criteria.

attributes.Name: accreditedIn
attributes.Description: Region or political jurisdiction such as a state, province or locale in which the credential, learning opportunity or assessment is accredited.

attributes.Name: FirstName
attributes.Description: The full legal first name given to a person at birth, baptism, or through legal change.

attributes.Name: LastOrSurname
attributes.Description: The full legal last name borne in common by members of a family.

attributes.Name: ElectronicMailAddress
attributes.Description: The numbers, letters, and symbols used to identify an electronic mail (e-mail) user within the network to which the person or organization belongs.

attributes.Name: PersonIdentifier
attributes.Description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a person by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.

attributes.Name: PersonIdentificationSystem
attributes.Description: A coding scheme that is used for identification of a person.

attributes.Name: PersonalInformationVerification
attributes.Description: The evidence by which a persons name, address, date of birth, etc. is confirmed.

attributes.Name: MiddleName
attributes.Description: A full legal middle name given to a person at birth, baptism, or through legal change.

attributes.Name: GenerationCodeOrSuffix
attributes.Description: An appendage, if any, used to denote a person's generation in his family (e.g., Jr., Sr., III).

attributes.Name: PersonalTitleOrPrefix
attributes.Description: An appellation, if any, used to denote rank, placement, or status (e.g., Mr., Ms., Reverend, Sister, Dr., Colonel).

attributes.Name: AddressTypeForLearnerOrFamily
attributes.Description: The type of address listed for a learner or a parent, guardian, family member or related person.

attributes.Name: AddressStreetNumberAndName
attributes.Description: The street number and street name or post office box number of an address.

attributes.Name: AddressApartmentRoomOrSuiteNumber
attributes.Description: The apartment, room, or suite number of an address.

attributes.Name: AddressCity
attributes.Description: The name of the city in which an address is located.

attributes.Name: StateAbbreviation
attributes.Description: The abbreviation for the state (within the United States) or outlying area in which an address is located.

attributes.Name: AddressPostalCode
attributes.Description: A number that identifies each postal delivery area in the United States used as a portion of an address.

attributes.Name: AddressCountyName
attributes.Description: The name of the county, parish, borough, or comparable unit (within a state) in which an address is located.

attributes.Name: CountryCode
attributes.Description: The unique two character International Organization for Standardization (ISO) code for the country in which an address is located.

attributes.Name: ProofOfResidencyType
attributes.Description: An accepted form of proof of residency in the district/county/other locality.

attributes.Name: Latitude
attributes.Description: The north or south angular distance from the equator that, when combined with longitude, reflects an estimation of where the address is physically situated.

attributes.Name: Longitude
attributes.Description: The east or west angular distance from the prime meridian that, when combined with latitude, reflects an estimation of where the address is physically situated.

attributes.Name: TelephoneNumber
attributes.Description: The telephone number including the area code, and extension, if applicable.

attributes.Name: TelephoneNumberType
attributes.Description: The type of communication number listed for a person.

attributes.Name: PrimaryTelephoneNumberIndicator
attributes.Description: An indication that the telephone number should be used as the principal number for a person or organization.

attributes.Name: ClassificationOfInstructionalProgramCode
attributes.Description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.

attributes.Name: ClassificationOfInstructionalProgramUse
attributes.Description: An indicator of whether the CIP Code is referencing an enrollment program or an award program.

attributes.Name: ClassificationOfInstructionalProgramVersion
attributes.Description: The version of CIP being reported.

attributes.Name: CreditsRequired
attributes.Description: The total number of credits required for a student to graduate from the school of enrollment or complete a program.

attributes.Name: DistanceEducationProgramEnrollmentIndicator
attributes.Description: An individual's enrollment in a program for which all the required coursework for program completion is able to be completed via distance education courses. Distance education is education that uses one or more technologies to deliver instruction to individuals who are separated from the instructor and to support regular and substantive interaction between the individuals and the instructor synchronously or asynchronously.

attributes.Name: NormalLengthOfTimeForCompletion
attributes.Description: The amount of time necessary for a person to complete all requirements for a degree or certificate according to the institution's catalog. This is typically 4 years (8 semesters or trimesters, or 12 quarters, excluding summer terms) for a bachelor's degree in a standard term-based institution; 2 years (4 semesters or trimesters, or 6 quarters, excluding summer terms) for an associate's degree in a standard term-based institution; and the various scheduled times for certificate programs.

attributes.Name: NormalLengthOfTimeForCompletionUnits
attributes.Description: The unit of measurement for length of time for completion.

attributes.Name: ProgramName
attributes.Description: The name of the program of instruction, training, services or benefits available through federal, state, or local agencies.

attributes.Name: ProgramIdentifier
attributes.Description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a program by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.

attributes.Name: ProgramLengthHours
attributes.Description: The normal length in credit/contact hours of a person's program as published in the institution's catalogue, website, or other official documents.

attributes.Name: ProgramLengthHoursType
attributes.Description: The type of hours (credit or contact) by which the normal length of a program of study is measured.

attributes.Name: ProgramSponsorType
attributes.Description: A type of organization providing funds for a particular educational or service program or activity or for an individual's participation in the program or activity.

attributes.Name: Work-basedLearningOpportunityType
attributes.Description: The type of work-based learning opportunity a student participated in.

attributes.Name: PostsecondaryProgramLevel
attributes.Description: The level describing the concentration of study for a postsecondary program.

attributes.Name: ProgramParticipationStartDate
attributes.Description: The year, month and day on which the person began to participate in a program.

attributes.Name: ProgramParticipationExitDate
attributes.Description: The year, month and day on which the person ceased to participate in a program.

attributes.Name: ProgramParticipationParticipationStatus
attributes.Description: The current status of the student's program participation

attributes.Name: ExitReason
attributes.Description: The documented or assumed reason a student is no longer being served by a special program.
